correctness.rationale: For the final repaired result, multiplication by S and the unit formula telescope to B₀(bS−Sb)=b on the algebra of maps into W. The maps annihilating W are the full kernel by dimensions. They form a sub-bimodule for the image algebra, so the induced inverse inner commutator is a derivation into the quotient and establishes the weight-zero identity by applying B₀. Stabilization forces U to preserve W and is equivalent to commutators with D=USU⁻¹−S vanishing on W. Taking a projection onto W first shows D preserves W; taking all endomorphisms of W then makes its restriction scalar. Conversely a scalar restriction satisfies the commutator condition. The column recurrence Ue_{j+1}=(S+tI)Ue_j and the last-coordinate vanishing for the first n−1 columns successively force Ue₁=ce₁ (all leading coefficients one), including n=2 and small characteristic. This gives exactly cP_t; substitution and the (1,2) entry give the additive, injective projective law. The diagonal degree shift proves scalar absorption, and the common-kernel dimensions zero and one separate the two image algebras. Transpose exchanges the actions by U↦U⁻ᵀ, so both orbit sizes are |GL_n(q)|/[q(q−1)]. Degree also bounds nilpotency and the unique top term from E_{n1} has coefficient (−1)^(n−1), nonzero in all characteristics. Inspected VERIFICATION.md and verify.py without executing them; the four exhaustive stabilizer tests are small prime-field cases, not the proof for all fields.

value.rationale: The symmetry of a canonical extremal operator naturally determines the number of presentations over finite fields. Ruling out hidden extra symmetries uniformly when characteristic is small relative to dimension is a substantive finite-dimensional rigidity statement; the dimension-based dual obstruction gives two distinct explicitly counted families. This is not simply rewriting known translations in the monomial basis and is not a global classification in positive characteristic.
